info.description: Outbound AI voice-calling platform for a real-estate brokerage (PSI). Lead files are ingested into a durable dial list, dials are paced against the configured calling window and caps, project questions are answered from ingested project sheets under a cite-or-refuse discipline, each conversation is qualified into one of three outcomes, and a warm lead is handed to a human broker through a whispered summary and a conference bridge. Offline by contract: no Store callbacks, no outbound HTTP except the one connector the operator configures, and the Twilio edge stubbed until an account and caller number exist.

Ask this tenant's corpus, or describe the surface when no question is given.

A GET with no ``q`` states what this surface answers FROM -- the
precedence.v1 ladder, the layers this property's own corpus can supply,
and the label an answer with no higher source would carry -- so an
operator (or the console) can see which layer an answer comes from before
asking. That is the same label every answer below carries.
